title: Run uproc-DNA using iMicrobe
author: Alise J Ponsero
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.u3jeykn

steps.title: Prepare Input Data
steps.instruction: Prepare the metagenomic sample data for analysis, ensuring compatibility with the tool's single-end read requirement.

substeps.instruction: Select the desired sample (e.g., SRS01342) from the iMicrobe sample search page and add it to the cart.
If using a paired-end read dataset, either pair the reads using tools like PEAR or Pandaseq, or prepare to run the analysis on the two files separately.

steps.title: Launch uproc_dna App
steps.instruction: Access and initialize the uproc_dna-1.2.0u3 application within the iMicrobe platform.

substeps.instruction: Provide the input files using the cart or the datastore.

steps.title: Configure Analysis Parameters
steps.instruction: Tune the application parameters before running the job.

substeps.instruction: Set ORF translation threshold level (default is 'More restrictive').
Set Protein threshold level (default is 'More restrictive').

steps.title: Retrieve and Access Results
steps.instruction: Locate the processed output files in the CyVerse datastore after the job has completed.

substeps.instruction: Select the job corresponding to the run and navigate to the 'Outputs' section.
Click 'Browse and view output files in the CyVerse Datastore'.
Navigate to the 'uproc-out' folder within the job folder to retrieve results.
